newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo, Fuji Elec win 29 bln yen Indonesia order.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo, Fuji Elec win 29 bln yen Indonesia order.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp said on Wednesday that it and Fuji Electric Co Ltd had won a 29 billion yen order from Indonesia to build the world's largest geothermal power generators.
The consortium is to build a geothermal power plant, with two 110,000 kilowatt (kw) generators, on Java, Indonesia, for independent power producer Mandala Nusantara Ltd, a Sumitomo spokesman said.
Mandala Nusantara is owned 85 percent by private power firm AsiaPower Ltd, while the remainder is held by investment firm PT Bumi Mandala Perkasa, he said.
The first of the two generators is scheduled to start commercial operations by March 1999, and the second one the end of 1999.
Mandala Nusantara plans to expand the capacity of the plant to 440,000 kw in the future, he added.
Under the terms of the contract, Sumitomo will supervise the project, while Fuji Electric will provide the generators.
Fuji Electric has held about 50 percent of the world's geothermal power generator market over the last 10 years, a spokesman for the manufacturer said.
